{{Short description|Theorem about cohomology rings}}
{{distinguish|Borel's theorem on power series}}
In [[topology]], a branch of [[mathematics]], '''Borel's theorem''', due to {{harvs|first=Armand|last=Borel|authorlink=Armand Borel|year=1953|txt}}, says the [[cohomology ring]] of a [[classifying space]] or a [[classifying stack]] is a [[polynomial ring]].<ref>{{harvnb|Behrend|2003|loc=Theorem 5.6.}}</ref>
